subtitle: Second-seat Haiku heals; Flash never does
synopsis: From seat two, Haiku immediately starts laddering potions at 60, 50, and 40 HP while Flash keeps swinging and dies still holding all three heals. The match matters because the seat flip exposes a completely different policy, not a tiny performance shift.

highlights.label: Third heal seals the policy gap
Flash dies with all 3 potions unused
